_: How YouK parts are allowed to meet, as data (docs/design/A2-rule-model.md). Read and checked by src/engine/rules.js: an unknown key, family, rule or placeholder stops the load by name. Which part is in which family comes from catalogue.json (carried there from snap-spec.json by make-catalogue), so membership is never listed twice. Every refusal carries the sentence a customer sees and where the rule came from.

frames._hollow: A ladder's bounding box is a frame around empty space; a hook strip hung on a rung sits inside it legitimately.

rules.says: The {label} has no fixing for a foot. Stand it on the floor, or hang it on the wall.
rules.source: MA 405462; FINDINGS 'Foot': only the 320 mm frames have the two holes in their underside

span.says: The {label} must rest on a ladder at both ends.
span.source: MA 406215 (shelf), MA 406208 (coat rail): every spanning part is fixed at both ladders

carcase.says: The {label} sits across two brackets; one end has nothing under it.

bolted.says: The {label} must be bolted to the part that carries it.
bolted._held: any-end, not every-end: the office arm carries two ALTERNATIVE bolt plugs at one hole (flat, or tilted 9 degrees) and uses one.

hang.says: The {label} must hang on a ladder.

product.says: That would put the {label} {mm} mm below the floor.
The {label} would take the space the {other} is already in.

preferences._byKind: Matt, 12 November 2026: a clothes rail goes on the highest rung that takes it (A1 F11). Lowest-first stays right for shelves, which then stack upward.
